verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs describe a fully hosted service where agents run in isolated cloud sandboxes (codegen-docs-5), are created/managed via API, SDK, CLI, or web UI (codegen-docs-15,16,12,31) without requiring the developer to host any backend, and provide telemetry/logs remotely (codegen-docs-27,30). This matches a managed cloud agent-running offering with no self-hosted infrastructure needed. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and explicit detail on scaling/quota limits of the managed backend.
